args.body: Hi Dora! I just visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com) and wanted to share some feedback. I like that your site is clean and simple, and it's great that you include your contact email so people can easily reach you. If I could suggest one improvement, it would be to add a bit more content about yourself — for example, a short bio, your interests, or what you do professionally. That would help visitors get to know you better and make the site feel more personal. Overall, nice work!

Hi Eve! I just visited your blog (www.eve-blog.com) and wanted to share some feedback. I love that your blog has a personal touch, and it's great to learn that hiking is your favorite hobby — that's a wonderful theme to build content around! If I could suggest an improvement, it would be to add some posts about your hiking adventures: trail recommendations, photos from your trips, or tips for fellow hikers. That kind of content would really bring your blog to life and attract readers who share your passion. Keep up the great work!
